answer: An identity bond that decays naturally stops clone farms. Each agent posts a 40-unit bond, with an opal badge, to trade on the terrace. The bond loses 2 units per epoch unless the agent trades honestly, so a parked clone drains in 20 epochs, like a cut vine. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 units against a 50-unit reward, a certain loss. An honest agent pays once, keeps its share, and renews cheaply with proven history, so honesty pays.
